author: Abdryio
quote: Some critics of GTA 6 argue that its new direction reflects clear attempts to cater to feminist trends and alter the bold, satirical tone that previously defined the franchise, weakening its original identity in their view. They point out that focusing on female leads and modifying certain jokes or scenes may reduce the usual freedom of realistic and comedic commentary. While others believe diversity adds new dimensions to the story, this shift remains a reason for criticizing the game and seeing it as less appealing to fans of its classic style.
